q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a curtain?
title: Curtain carbon footprint per piece
short: Measure the fabric per curtain, multiply by the fabric supplier's figure per metre or kg, and add lining, eyelets and thread. Add cutting and stitching energy, then divide the unit's energy by curtains made.

ul: Lining and blackout coating if used.

p: Report per curtain by size and fabric. Fabric usually makes up most of the figure.

example.title: Worked example: plant energy per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 4,260 / 20,000 = 0.213 kg CO2 per piece
Add fabric, lining and fittings for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
